transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just... having a hard time lately. I guess I spend a lot of my day checking things around the house. Like the outlets, the locks, my tools... even just dust. I go back over them again and again. I try to fix things, but I just keep checking until I'm completely worn out. I just... I never feel sure enough to leave it alone.
Do you check these things because you're afraid something bad might happen if you don't?

...Yeah. I guess. It's just... even when I know I did a job right, these... ugly thoughts just keep jumping in. Like... a loose wire I missed is gonna burn the house down. Or maybe a nail I left somewhere is gonna hurt my wife. I try to push them out, but... they just come right back stronger.
Do you ever feel like you have to perform these checks in a specific way or a certain number of times to try and prevent these bad things from happening?

I don't... I don't really know about a specific number. It's just... like I said, I spend most of my day going back over the same things. The locks, the outlets... I just keep checking and fixing them again and again. I do it until I'm just... completely worn out. And even then, I still don't feel sure enough to leave it alone.
Do you feel like you have to check these things in a particular order or sequence?
No... I don't think so. It's not really an order. I just... whatever I see first, or whatever I'm worried about right then, I just go to it. There's no real pattern to it, I guess.
Do you feel like checking these things helps to prevent the bad things you're afraid of from actually happening?
I don't really know. I guess... I'm not sure if it actually stops anything. I just... I just feel like I have to do it. That's all.
Do you ever feel like you need to check something a certain number of times before you can stop?
I... I thought I just answered that. No. I don't count them or anything. I just... I just keep doing it until I'm too tired to keep going. There isn't a specific number.
Do you ever feel the need to repeat certain words or phrases to yourself?
No. I don't do that. I just... no.
Do you ever have unwanted thoughts or images that keep repeating in your mind?

Yeah. I mean... yeah. Just... ugly thoughts, I guess. Like, even if I know I did a job right, these thoughts just keep jumping in. Telling me I missed a loose wire and it's gonna burn the house down, or... or I left a nail somewhere and my wife's gonna get hurt. I try to push them out of my head, but... they just come right back stronger. So... yeah.
Do you feel like checking these things makes the ugly thoughts go away or makes you feel better about the worries you have?

Not really. I mean... no. It doesn't. I just... I spend most of my day going back over the same things. The outlets, the locks... my tools. Even the dust in the house. I just keep checking them and... fixing them, again and again. 

It doesn't make me feel better. I just do it until I'm completely worn out. And even then, I... I still don't feel sure enough to just leave it alone.
Do you feel like the things you check need to be in a certain condition or state, like being perfectly clean or arranged, for you to feel okay about them?
I don't know about perfectly clean or arranged. I just... I just need them to be right. I guess. I don't know how to explain it. It's just... they have to be right.
Do you feel like the things you check need to be symmetrical or exactly in their place for you to feel okay about them?
No. Not... not like that. It's not about being even, or lined up. I just... I just have to be sure it's safe. That's all.
Do you think that if you could just get everything checked one more time, you would finally feel at peace and like you could stop checking?
I don't know. I mean... I always think one more time will be enough. But it never is. I just... I don't think I'll ever feel at peace with it.
Do you feel like you're trying to make things perfect when you check them, rather than just making sure they're safe?
No... I don't care if it's perfect. I just... it's just about being safe. That's it.
Do you think something terrible will happen if you don't check these things?

Yeah... I guess. It's just... even when I know I did a job right, these ugly thoughts just keep jumping into my head. Like... like maybe there's a loose wire I missed and it's gonna burn the whole house down. Or... or a nail I left somewhere is gonna hurt my wife. I try to push them out of my head, I really do, but... they just come right back stronger.
Do you feel like checking these things gives you a sense of control over what might happen?
I don't really know. Um... I haven't really thought about it like that. I just... I just do it.
Do you feel like the things you check need to be in a specific order or have a specific arrangement for you to feel okay about them?
No... I don't think so. It doesn't matter how they're arranged or anything. I just... I just need to know it's safe. That's all.
Do you feel like the things you check need to be exactly as you left them for you to feel okay about them?
Um... no, not really. I don't... it's not about how I left them. I just... I just look to make sure it's safe. That's all.
Do you feel like the things you check are ever 'just right' or is it always about safety?
I don't... I don't really know what you mean by just right. It's... it's always just about the safety. Like I said.
Do you feel like checking these things is the only way to prevent the bad things you're afraid of from happening?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... I don't know what else to do. If I don't check, I just... I can't stop thinking about it. So I just spend most of the day going back over the same outlets and locks... the tools in the garage... even just the dust in the house. I just keep checking and fixing them again and again. I get so worn out, but I still... I still don't feel sure enough to just leave it alone. So yeah, I guess checking is the only way.
Do you feel like the things you check need to be in a specific or perfect state for you to feel okay about them?
I don't... I don't know about perfect. I just... I just need to know it's safe. Like I said before. It's just about making sure nothing bad happens.
